title: Recursive Paintboxes and the Martin Boundary of the Hoffman Rooted-Tree Graph
summary: We determine the Doob-Martin boundary of Hoffman's leaf-grafting graph on finite unlabelled non-plane rooted trees. Its full and minimal boundaries coincide and are parametrized by deterministic recursive paintboxes, identified when their finite sampling laws agree. Every central measure is a unique mixture of the corresponding extremal laws, and its limiting boundary point generates the completed tail field.
